from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

url = 'https://www.seriouseats.com/the-best-roast-potatoes-ever-recipe'
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={\"width\": 1440, \"height\": 900})
    page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4001/?feature=duplicate', wait_until='networkidle')
    stack = page.locator('.bookmark-stack')
    assert stack.locator('.card').count() == 8
    page.locator('#addLink').click()
    page.get_by_label('Web address').fill(url)
    page.locator('#save').click()
    target = page.locator('#duplicateTarget')
    assert 'duplicate-highlight' in (target.get_attribute('class') or '')
    assert stack.locator('.card').count() == 8
    assert page.get_by_text('8 saved bookmarks').is_visible()
    assert page.get_by_text('Already saved').is_visible()
    assert page.get_by_text('Already saved — here it is in your collection').is_visible()
    page.screenshot(path='prototypes/duplicate-bookmark.png', full_page=False)
    browser.close()
print('Duplicate-save flow checked: count remains 8 and the existing bookmark is scrolled into view and highlighted.')
